purpose: Extend the V9 expression vocabulary with four clearly separable source poses. Complete poses are source art only; later runtime frames must compose only registered brows, mouth, cheek, and optional accent components with the fixed V22 open-eye Rig.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole character identity reference: fixed open black eye silhouette, eye scale and spacing, one primary highlight plus one small sparkle per eye, centered nose anchor, monochrome ink weight, and whitespace

reference_policy: Locked V9 is the sole prompt image. Historical/rejected extension art, V10+, legacy faces, V41 preview frames, whole-face runtime cards, and custom code art are forbidden inputs and fallbacks.
identity_locks: Every pose is the same centered V9 Companion character on a pure white background.
Keep the two open rounded black V9 eye silhouettes at the same scale and spacing, with exactly one white primary highlight and one small white sparkle in each eye.
Keep the small centered V9 nose anchor. Do not introduce pupils, eyelashes, eyelids, winks, a face outline, new eye shape, color, gray, antialiasing, texture, labels, borders, panels, or UI.

emotion_contract.name: delighted
emotion_contract.read: both brows visibly lifted and open, a clearly wider rounded upturned mouth, and higher fuller cheeks; cheerful but still restrained

emotion_contract.name: bashful
emotion_contract.read: soft brows gently converging inward, a small compact shy smile, and visibly closer rounded cheeks; cute and quiet rather than worried

emotion_contract.name: thoughtful
emotion_contract.read: one brow distinctly higher while the other stays relaxed, a small off-center thinking mouth, and one subtly lifted cheek; no punctuation

emotion_contract.name: focused
emotion_contract.read: two low gently inward brows, a short confident compact mouth, and calm low cheeks; attentive and determined but never angry

separation_contract.pairwise_rule: Every pair differs in at least two visible component groups. No pair may share both brow-pair geometry and mouth geometry.
separation_contract.runtime_rule: The four complete poses are source art only. Later previews and target frames must use registered source components; they may not replay a complete pose card.
